measurementBoundary: verified principals -> Gateway -> DO -> production adapter/Neon and genuine UploadThing callback; join includes baseline, asset download/decode and socket fanout
limitations: OAuth, web proof issuance and UI application are excluded; asset presign session and rate-limit spans are measured
hot DO maintained by live presence traffic; Vercel/Neon cold starts are not independently classified
asset and snapshot service/DB spans are measured; snapshot response delivery, callback dispatch, RPC handler-external waiting and provider/network attribution remain unclassified

measurementValidity.limitation: Compares deployment identity before fixture creation and before cleanup; web deployments are not independently observed.

afterRetirementBeforeStorageDeletion.limitation: Observed after end-room, expired proofs and cleanup deployment; not failure-time queue occupancy.

workerObservability.limitation: Live tail can sample or drop events; unscoped failures and platform exceptions cannot be attributed to this fixture. Exception classes match fixed documented phrases, not raw messages. No historical log permission.

vercelFailureObservation.source: Vercel CLI 62.0.0 bounded historical request query and request-id expansion
vercelFailureObservation.limitation: The request record confirms HTTP 500 but provides no exception or application error cause. Failed response body and platform error headers were not retained by this tools version.

postCleanupProviderUsage.limitation: Read after owned fixtures were deleted, not at failure time. Does not measure request quotas or provider availability.
